description: This is a front-end source file (HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript) for a web-based database visualizer interface. It provides UI components to browse databases, tables, and display data interactively.
external_files: API endpoints for fetching databases, tables, and table data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the server and updates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the table list for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data with clickable cells for expansion.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell, handling nulls, objects, long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing of long text or objects.
